items: Comment-span wrap still occurring after v9.99.646: debug HTML revealed that `normalizeCommentSpans` was not handling the second MusicBrainz DOM variant for `span.comment`. Variant A (assumed so far) has `(` and `)` as separate text-node siblings of `<bdi>`. Variant B (the actual failing cases) has all content already inside `<bdi>`, with only pure-whitespace text nodes (`\n      `) surrounding it — these collapse to spaces and create wrap opportunities before and after the `<bdi>`. Steps 2–4 were guarded by `node.textContent.trim() !== ''` which correctly skipped pure-whitespace nodes but left them in place, causing the browser to still break there. Rewrote `normalizeCommentSpans` to explicitly remove ALL pure-whitespace text-node children of `span.comment` (Step 2), handle Variant A leading/trailing text (Steps 3–4), and then apply `white-space: nowrap` to both `span.comment` and its `<bdi>` child (Step 5). The `white-space: nowrap` is now safe because: (a) all whitespace-only text nodes have been removed so no wrap opportunities remain internally, and (b) the `<bdi>` content's min-content width is unchanged — only surrounding whitespace nodes were removed. Also fixed `totalWidth` rounding in `toggleAutoResizeColumns`: the reduce now uses `Math.ceil(w + 20)` to match `th.style.minWidth`, preventing the table from being set narrower than the sum of its column `minWidth` constraints.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Syntax error in v9.99.645: a Python string `\n` in the inline comment for Step 2 of `normalizeCommentSpans` was written as a literal newline into the JS source, splitting the `//` comment across two lines and leaving a bare string token that the JS parser rejected. Fixed by escaping to `\\n` in the comment text.

Step 2 of `normalizeCommentSpans` improved: instead of merely stripping trailing whitespace from the `(\n ` text node preceding `` (which left `(` as a standalone text sibling still able to create a break at the span boundary), Step 2 now moves the trimmed `(` content into the front of the `` and removes the text node entirely. The resulting structure is `(disambiguation text)` — the entire comment content is inside a single ``, with no text nodes outside it and no break opportunities remaining inside `span.comment`.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Comment-span wrap still occurring after v9.99.644: the provided post-normalisation HTML revealed a third break point that was not being fixed. The full MusicBrainz `span.comment` source structure contains three independent soft-wrap opportunities: (A) a pure-whitespace text node between `` and `` — fixed in v9.99.644 Pass 1; (B) whitespace inside `span.comment` between the opening `(` text node and the `` child, i.e. `(\n ` — the newline+spaces collapse to a space giving a break between `(` and the text; (C) the `)` bidi-boundary from earlier fixes. `normalizeCommentSpans` is now rewritten as a single consolidated per-span loop handling all three: Step 1 removes (A) as before; Step 2 strips trailing whitespace from any text node immediately preceding a `` inside `span.comment` (turning `(\n ` into `(`), eliminating break point (B); Step 3 moves non-empty text after `` into the ``, eliminating (C). The function is still idempotent and still called before the measurement batch in `toggleAutoResizeColumns`.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Column wrap still occurring after v9.99.643: `normalizeCommentSpans` only fixed the `)` bidi-boundary break inside `span.comment`, but a second independent break point remained — the whitespace-only text node (`\n `) between `` and ``, which collapses to a space and gives the browser a valid line-break opportunity before the entire comment block. Added Pass 1 to `normalizeCommentSpans`: for every `span.comment` whose immediately preceding sibling is a pure-whitespace text node preceded by an element, that text node is removed, making `` and `` adjacent with no intervening break point. Also added a `normalizeCommentSpans(table)` call inside `toggleAutoResizeColumns` before the measurement batch phase, so the source DOM is normalised before nodes are cloned into the measurement sandbox — ensuring the measured column width exactly matches the width the live cell needs after normalisation.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Infinite loop / 100% CPU hang introduced in v9.99.642: `normalizeCommentSpans()` used `Array.from(commentSpan.childNodes)` to snapshot child nodes, then decremented the loop index `i--` after moving a text node into its preceding `<bdi>`. Because `children` is a static array, the already-moved text node remained at `children[i+1]` after `appendChild`; the `i--` caused the same `<bdi>`/text-node pair to be re-evaluated on every iteration, looping forever. Fixed by removing the `i--`: after `node.appendChild(next)` the loop's own `i++` advances to `children[i+1]` (the now-detached text node), which cannot match `tagName === 'BDI'`, so the condition is safely false and the loop continues to `children[i+2]`.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Bidi-boundary `</bdi>)` wrap — third and final fix (supersedes v9.99.639–641): the CSS approach used in v9.99.641 (`table.tbl td span.comment { white-space: nowrap }`) was fundamentally flawed: applying `white-space: nowrap` to `span.comment` in the live table changes those spans' min-content width to their full single-line text width, causing `table-layout: auto` to re-redistribute column widths on every layout pass — squeezing other columns or leaving the comment column too narrow, so the entire comment block dropped to a new row. Replaced with DOM normalisation: a new `normalizeCommentSpans(table)` function walks every `td span.comment`, finds any non-empty text node that immediately follows a `<bdi>` child (the orphan `)`), and moves it inside the preceding `<bdi>`. This removes the inter-element boundary that the browser's bidi-isolate algorithm treats as a soft wrap opportunity, without altering any inline metrics or triggering layout recalculation side-effects. Called at all three post-render sites (filter/sort path, main render end, grouped-table/CAA path) alongside `applyZebraStriping`. The CSS rule from v9.99.641 and the per-cell JS from v9.99.640 were both removed.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Bidi-boundary `</bdi>)` wrap in non-sticky columns (e.g. 'Release title') — the fix from v9.99.639/640 only covered sticky column `<td>` cells via JS in `applyStickyColumn._apply()`. Non-sticky cells (e.g. Release title on recording pages) suffered the same `</bdi>)` wrap: the closing ")" after the `<bdi>` in `<span class="comment">` broke to a new visual row because `<bdi>`'s `unicode-bidi:isolate` UA-stylesheet property terminates the bidi run and creates a soft wrap opportunity before the ")" text node. Fixed by replacing the per-cell JS approach with a single global CSS rule injected in `applyStickyHeaders()`: `table.tbl td span.comment { white-space: nowrap }`. This covers all cells — sticky and non-sticky — in one declaration. The column measurement sandbox already uses `white-space:nowrap` via `.mb-measure-nowrap`, so measured column widths already account for the full single-line comment width; the CSS rule makes the live cell match. The obsolete `cell.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap'` statement on sticky `<td>` cells (v9.99.640) was removed.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Sticky column content wrap — second fix (supersedes v9.99.639): the v9.99.639 fix applied `white-space: nowrap` only to `span.comment` elements, which stopped the `)` bidi-boundary break but exposed a second, outer wrap point: the whitespace text node between `` and `` allowed the entire comment block to drop to a new visual row. Root cause: two independent wrap opportunities exist in sticky Title/Name/Recording cells — (1) the inter-element whitespace between the title anchor and the comment span, and (2) the `unicode-bidi: isolate` bidi-boundary inside `span.comment` before the trailing `)`. The measurement div correctly captures the full single-line width under `white-space: nowrap`, but the live `` had no such constraint. Fix: apply `white-space: nowrap` directly to the sticky `` cell in `applyStickyColumn._apply()`, eliminating all wrap opportunities in one declaration. Safe because sticky column cells contain only inline content (anchors, bdi, span.comment) and never block-level elements.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Sticky column (Title/Name/etc.) optimal width not properly calculated for cells containing `(…text…)`: the closing ")" text node after `` was wrapping to a new visual line due to the browser treating the `unicode-bidi: isolate` boundary of `` as a soft wrap opportunity. Fixed by applying `white-space: nowrap` to every `span.comment` element inside sticky body cells in `applyStickyColumn._apply()`, preventing the `)` bidi-boundary line-break in the live table. Affects all multi-table relationship pages (e.g. artist/relationships) where recording titles include live-event disambiguation comments.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Single-column sorts now show the same value-change shade banding as multi-column sorts: `applyMultiSortColumnTints()` synthesises a one-entry column list from `state.lastSortIndex` / `state.sortState` when `multiSortColumns` is empty, so the amber alternating tint (classes `mb-mscol-0a` / `mb-mscol-0b`) is applied to the sorted column and the column header is tinted whenever any single column is sorted. Tints are cleared on sort restore. The re-apply path after re-renders also covers the single-sort case.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Removed auto-clearing `setTimeout` calls from the retry-eviction (`mb-info-display-rel`) and IDB-sweep (`mb-info-display-generic`) toasts. Messages now persist in their sub-container until overwritten by the next message in the same slot, instead of disappearing after a fixed delay.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Added async 'IndexedDB Cache' section (🗄️) to the Stats panel between Global Statistics and Table Details, showing: record counts for all three IDB stores (`images`, `metadata`, `rel-ws2`) fetched via `IDBObjectStore.count()`; L1 art memory cache size; L1 rel WS2 memory cache size; last sweep timestamp and deleted-record count; TTL eviction count (read-time); retry eviction count (user-initiated).
Added `_artIdbCountStore(storeName)` helper: opens the shared IDB and returns `objectStore.count()` as a Promise, resolving to 0 on any error.

Extended `_artIdbSweepExpired()` to also sweep the `rel-ws2` store (using `_REL_IDB_TTL_MS`); records the total deleted count and timestamp in module-level `_artIdbLastSweep`; fires a `mb-info-display-generic` toast ('🗄️ Sweep: removed N expired IDB records') cleared after 6 s when any records were deleted.
Added module-level `_relIdbTtlEvictCount` counter: incremented in `_relIdbGet()` whenever a record fails the TTL check and is deleted.

Added module-level `_relIdbRetryEvictCount` counter: incremented in `_relRetryMbids()` by the number of MBIDs whose IDB records were force-deleted; fires a `mb-info-display-rel` toast ('🔗 Retry: evicted N IDB records') cleared after 5 s.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: keyboard shortcuts (bug 1): make Ctrl+K ('Show keyboard shortcuts help') configurable — replaced the hard-wired e.key==='K' check with isShortcutEvent(e, 'sa_shortcut_show_shortcuts_help', 'Ctrl+K'); new setting sa_shortcut_show_shortcuts_help (default: Ctrl+K) added before sa_shortcut_open_settings in the configurable-direct-shortcuts block.

keyboard shortcuts (bug 4): apply the direct-Ctrl+letter guard inside the column-filter-focused shortcuts section too — Ctrl+O, Ctrl+Q, Ctrl+A, Ctrl+R, and Ctrl+V are now blocked when sa_enable_direct_ctrl_char_shortcuts is false (the target is an INPUT, so the same rule that applies globally applies in the column filter context). Ctrl+ArrowUp, Ctrl+ArrowDown, and Ctrl+# are non-letter keys and remain unaffected.
keyboard shortcuts popup (bug 4): annotate column-filter-focused shortcuts Ctrl+O/Q/A/R/V with '— blocked when direct Ctrl+letter shortcuts are disabled' to match the actual runtime behaviour.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: keyboard shortcuts (bug 2): add sa_toggle_barcode_highlighting (default: Ctrl+B) — new configurable shortcut that emulates clicking the #mb-barcode-highlight-btn button to toggle barcode row highlighting. Added before sa_shortcut_open_density in the configurable-direct-shortcuts block and handled in initKeyboardShortcuts.
keyboard shortcuts (bug 3): add 'b' → Toggle Barcode Highlighting to ctrlMFunctionMap so the action is also reachable via the prefix key followed by B.
keyboard shortcuts popup: add Ctrl+B (barcode toggle) to the 'View & Layout' section; update the prefix-mode sub-key list to include B.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: keyboard shortcuts: suppress direct Ctrl+<letter> (a–z) shortcuts while an input field has focus or a UI dialog is open (default new behaviour) — prevents conflicts with well-known browser/OS shortcuts and avoids accidental triggers while typing in filter fields. Ctrl+M (prefix key) and Ctrl+U (unicode picker) are explicitly excluded from this guard. Non-letter shortcuts (Ctrl+,, Ctrl+2, Ctrl+3, Ctrl+Shift+G, etc.) and column-filter-focused shortcuts are also unaffected.

keyboard shortcuts: add new boolean setting 'Enable Direct Ctrl+Letter Shortcuts' (sa_enable_direct_ctrl_char_shortcuts, default: false) in the KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS section to restore the previous unrestricted behaviour.

keyboard shortcuts: add G (focus global filter) and C (cycle column filter) to the prefix-mode function map (ctrlMFunctionMap) so these actions are always reachable via Ctrl+M, G / Ctrl+M, C even when direct Ctrl+<letter> shortcuts are suppressed.

keyboard shortcuts: move _colFilterTableIndex to module scope (renamed from local currentTableIndex) so the column-filter cycling state is accessible to both the keydown handler and the new prefix-mode entry.

keyboard shortcuts: add isSpecialDialogOpen() helper that detects whether any of the script's modal dialogs (shortcuts help, app help, stats panel, export/save/load dialogs, settings overlay) is currently in the DOM.

keyboard shortcuts: update the 'Show Keyboard Shortcuts' popup — note at the bottom now reflects the active mode; 'Filter & Search' and 'View & Layout' entries annotate which shortcuts are blocked while typing and list their prefix-mode equivalents; a new 'Keyboard Shortcuts' entry lists all prefix-mode letter sub-keys.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: status line: add a muted '|' divider (#mb-status-divider) between #mb-global-status-display and #mb-info-display; automatically shown/hidden by _setInfoSub() whenever any info sub-span becomes visible or is cleared.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: status line: add meaningful tooltips to all #mb-info-display-generic write sites — auto-resize (column measurement details, toggle hint), manual column resize (size + resize-button hint), restore widths, table density (cycle hint), export (format + row count), serialized to disk (load-from-disk hint), load from disk (pre-filter context or explore hint). showDownloadNotification gains a statusTip parameter so showExportNotification can pass a format-aware tooltip.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: status line: split #mb-info-display into three independent sub-spans — #mb-info-display-caa (CAA/EAA artwork completion), #mb-info-display-rel (Relationships completion), #mb-info-display-generic (everything else). All three can coexist without overwriting each other. Added _setInfoSub(id, text, tip) helper to manage visibility (display:none when empty). CAA and Rels sub-displays use the same compact format and tooltips as the global status segments. All sub-displays are cleared on each new render start.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: status line: simplify 🔗Rels and 🎨CAA/EAA segments to show only the elapsed time (e.g. '🔗Rels: 11s', '🎨CAA: 9s') — detailed tier breakdown moved to tooltip only. CAA label now reflects the active archive ('CAA' or 'EAA') via _getActiveArtCtx().

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: fix: 🔗Rels segment was appended to the global status line multiple times when repeating a filter operation. Added _relGlobalStatusDone guard (mirroring the existing _caaGlobalStatusDone pattern) so the segment is only appended once per load.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: fix: barcode highlighting — cells appeared only bold (no background color). Four root causes fixed: (1) barcodeProcessTable used th.textContent.trim() === 'Barcode' to find the Barcode column index; after makeTableSortableUnified wraps headers in .mb-col-hdr-flex with sort icons and a count badge, textContent includes '⇅▲▼📊' so the match always failed (barcodeColIdx = -1). Fixed by using _cleanColHeaderText(th) which reads th.dataset.colName. Same fix applied to addBarcodeHighlightToggleButton's hasBarcodeColumn check. (2) In runFilter and renderGroupedTable, initBarcodeHighlight ran before applyStickyColumn; applyStickyColumn calls td.style.background = '' on non-sticky cells which clears any inline background-color. Fixed by moving initBarcodeHighlight to after applyStickyColumn in both call sites. (3) startFetchingProcess has a second 'RENDERING END' applyStickyColumn pass (shared by both table modes) that ran after initBarcodeHighlight in the individual mode paths, wiping barcode colors on every initial render. Fixed by adding initBarcodeHighlight() after this final sticky pass. (4) The applyStickyColumn _leave hover handler did td.style.background = '' on non-sticky cells, which wiped barcode backgroundColor after any hover-out. Fixed: _leave now restores from td.dataset.mbRestBg when set; barcodeProcessTable updates mbRestBg to the barcode color when highlighting and deletes it when un-highlighting, so _leave correctly restores barcode colors after hover.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: fix: CAA/EAA image loading stalls after column filter — root cause: initCaaPics() recreated _caaQueue on every filter run but left the old queue (from the initial 8100-row render) running in the background, saturating the browser connection pool and causing the new queue's img.load events to be silently dropped by the browser. Fix: makeCaaQueue() gains a cancel() method that drops all pending tasks and marks the queue inert; initCaaPics() now calls _caaQueue.cancel() before replacing the queue, limiting the old queue to at most sa_caa_fetch_concurrency in-flight requests at the moment of cancellation. Additionally: _artGmFetchBlob gains timeout:30000 and an onabort handler so GM_xmlhttpRequest aborts/hangs reject the promise instead of deadlocking the queue; native img load path gains a 30-second watchdog timer that resolves the task if the browser silently drops the request.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: perf: incremental filter narrowing (Pattern 1) — single-table mode now tracks the last full testRowMatch scan result; when the new globalQuery is a plain-text extension of the previous query and all flags/column-filters are unchanged, only the previous match set is re-tested instead of all of allRows. Reduces O(8100) scan to O(prev_matches) for each additional character typed. Disabled automatically for regex and exclude modes (non-monotonic semantics). Invalidated by fetch, sort, disk-load, and any flag or column-filter change.

perf: rAF chunked render (Pattern 4) — renderRowsChunked now yields between chunks via requestAnimationFrame instead of setTimeout(0), guaranteeing one browser paint per chunk so the progress counter is always visible on screen. The abort-token generation check runs immediately after each rAF yield as before.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: fix: eliminate forced synchronous layout (FSL) reflows in initCollapsableColumns — the inner multiRowCells.forEach loop previously did write(whiteSpace=nowrap) → read(scrollWidth) → write(whiteSpace=prevWS) per cell, causing one full-table layout reflow per multi-row cell (thousands of reflows = 100–200 s freeze on 8 k+ row tables). Now all DOM writes are completed first, then a single batch pass sets whiteSpace:nowrap on all first-<li> elements, reads all scrollWidths in one pass (triggering exactly one layout flush per column instead of one per cell), then resets whiteSpace. Reduces O(cells) FSLs to O(columns) FSLs, eliminating the Chrome 'Page Unresponsive' freeze.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: fix: initCollapsableColumns perf — three targeted changes eliminate the 30–120 s post-render freeze on 8 k+ row tables: (1) both _updateAllColHeaderCounts(table) call sites deferred via setTimeout(0) so the O(rows × columns) getCleanColumnText scan runs after the browser paints the rendered rows instead of blocking the event loop; (2) five separate querySelectorAll cleanup passes consolidated into one combined selector walk, saving ~4 full DOM traversals (≈ 2–8 s on 65 k+ element tables); (3) Array.from(table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')) hoisted above collapsableColumns.forEach so the tbody snapshot is computed once instead of once per collapsable column, eliminating O(N × C) redundant DOM walks. Chrome 'Page Unresponsive' dialog no longer appears and reported rendering time drops to reflect only actual row-insertion cost.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: fix: render-generation abort token — adds module-level _renderGeneration counter incremented at the start of every renderFinalTable and renderGroupedTable call. renderRowsChunked accepts a generation parameter and checks _renderGeneration after each setTimeout(0) yield; if superseded it removes the progress overlay and returns immediately. Fixes a race where comfortable-speed typing produced interleaved highlights: runFilter('cook') rendered 27 correct rows via the fast synchronous path, but an older renderRowsChunked continuation (from runFilter('c'), ~1500 rows → chunked) was still queued and kept appending stale rows with 'c' highlights to the same tbody after its first setTimeout(0) yielded. renderGroupedTable also increments the counter (so any concurrent single-table renderRowsChunked aborts) and guards its post-render hook block (initExpandRGsFeature, initBarcodeHighlight, initCaaPics, initEaaPics, etc.) behind a generation check for future-proofing.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: perf: filter result cache — _filterResultCache (Map, max 50 entries, oldest evicted) caches the set of source TR elements that pass each unique filter configuration. On cache hit the O(N) testRowMatch(matchOnly=true) pass is skipped; cloning, highlighting, and rendering always run fresh. Cache is keyed on normalised query + flags + per-column filter specs (JSON). Invalidated on fetch start, disk-load, and sort completion via _invalidateFilterCache(). Both single-table and per-group multi-table paths are covered.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: perf: adaptive debounce delay — _adaptiveFilterDelay() computes the debounce interval as max(floor, 0.05 ms × rows_above_500, capped at 1000 ms). The user-configured sa_filter_debounce_delay becomes the floor (minimum), not a fixed value. debounce() now accepts a factory function for its wait argument so the delay is re-evaluated on every keystroke. All three filter debounce sites (global, column, sub-table) use the adaptive delay.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: perf: two-phase column filter matching in testRowMatch() — plain-text cellText.includes() (cheap, cached) is now checked first; querySelector for sentinel sort-key spans (.mb-inline-art-sort-key, .mb-caa-sort-key, .mb-eaa-sort-key) only runs when the plain check misses. Regexp filters bypass phase 1 and go directly to regexp.test(). Also adds a global short-circuit: the column filter loop is skipped entirely when the global filter has already rejected the row.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: perf: WeakMap text cache for source rows in testRowMatch() — getCleanVisibleText and getCleanColumnText results are now cached per source row in a WeakMap (_rowTextCache) and reused across filter keystrokes. Cache entries are populated lazily (_cachedFullText / _cachedColText) on the matchOnly=true pass and are GC'd automatically when allRows / groupedRows are replaced on a new fetch.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: perf: test-before-clone in runFilter() — source rows are now matched with testRowMatch(matchOnly=true) before cloneNode(), so only passing rows are cloned. testRowMatch gains a matchOnly parameter that skips all DOM mutations (highlight reset and application) for use on source rows; highlights are applied on the clone in a second call.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: CAA/EAA segment in mb-global-status-display was appended after every filter re-render because _showCaaCompletionToast fires on every _caaQueue.onIdle(). Fix: add _caaGlobalStatusDone flag; only the first call per page load appends to globalStatusDisplay. Flag resets when globalStatusDisplay.innerHTML is cleared at load start.
Rels tooltip was using CAA-style emojis (🟢/🗄️/🔵) instead of the compact-display emojis (📦/💾/🌐). Fixed to use consistent 📦 IDB / 💾 cache / 🌐 net throughout.
Compact status display segments (🔗Rels and 🎨CAA) showed all tier counts including zeros. Now only non-zero tiers are included in the compact string.
Tooltips for both 🔗Rels and 🎨CAA segments now always show all tiers (zero-count tiers explicitly shown as ':0' rather than suppressed).

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Compact Rels status display: remove 'entities'/'cells' labels and spacing; format is now '🔗Rels: N/N·📦N/💾N/🌐N·Xms' (entities/cells · tier counts · time).
Rels tooltip now uses the 4-tier CAA convention (🟢 Memory cache / 🗄️ IndexedDB cache / 🔵 Network fetch) with zero-count tiers suppressed, replacing the previous 📦/💾/🌐 labels.

Add CAA/EAA artwork segment to mb-global-status-display after 📐Measuring (and before 🔗Rels), in a mirrored compact format '🎨CAA: icon/inline·🟢N/🗄️N/🔵N/🌐N·Xms', with a multi-line tooltip showing the full per-tier icon+inline breakdown. The mb-info-display '🎨 CAA/EAA: N images in Xms' line is unchanged.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Redesign mb-global-status-display as structured tooltip-aware spans. Each segment (Loaded, Fetching, Rendering, Measuring, Rels) is now a separate <span title='…'> child, making the text more compact and adding hover tooltips: 'Loaded N pages (M rows)' explains the source is the MusicBrainz database; 'Fetching' and 'Rendering' explain the timing stages; '📐Measuring' explains sa_auto_resize_columns; '🔗Rels' shows a multi-line tooltip breaking down 📦 IDB / 💾 memory cache / 🌐 live WS2 API fetch counts.

Condense status display text: 'from MusicBrainz' moved to tooltip; separators changed to '; ' / ', '; labels shortened to 'Fetching:', 'Rendering:', '📐Measuring:', '🔗Rels:'; tier emojis 📦/💾/🌐 replace verbose 'IDB:'/'cache:'/'net:' labels.
Add _sdAppend(text, sep, tip) helper to globalStatusDisplay creation scope for appending structured segments from any call site.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Relationship load-complete toast now shows a per-tier fetch breakdown: 📦 IDB (Phase-1 IndexedDB hits), 💾 cache (L1 memory cache hits during Phase-2), and 🌐 net (live network fetches during Phase-2). The tier line is omitted when all counts are zero.

When all relationships have finished loading, append a condensed summary to the mb-global-status-display status line after 'Columnsize measuring time', e.g. '🔗 Rels: 50 entities · 50 cells · IDB:35·cache:2·net:13 · 55.2s'.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix Relationship column correctness when the user types in the filter while the Phase-2 fetch queue is still mid-flight (race condition between the throttled MBID queue and runFilter's DOM rebuild). Three-part fix: (1) _populateCells now syncs icon HTML to source-row cells (groupedRows/allRows) immediately after each MBID completes, so runFilter clones already carry the correct content; the premature relDone='1' stamp on source cells (before icons were built) is removed and moved to the correct position after the sync. (2) runFilter calls initRelationshipsColumn() after renderFinalTable/renderGroupedTable whenever any td.mb-rel-cell without data-rel-done='1' is found, so cells cloned from not-yet-processed MBIDs are populated in the freshly rendered DOM. (3) The queue.then() bulk sync is kept as a safety net but skips source cells whose innerHTML already matches the DOM cell, avoiding redundant work.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix batch measurement producing identical widths for every column (bugs 1–3): the previous <table>+<tr><td> approach placed all cells in a single table column, so the browser collapsed every offsetWidth to the same value — the maximum across the entire table. Replace with a plain <div> container holding display:inline-block wrappers; each wrapper is independently sized to its own content, giving correct per-column maximum widths.
Empty columns now correctly take the header width (sort icons, collapse button, CAA/EAA flex header) since headers are measured in the same batch and no longer share their width with data-row cells.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Replace per-cell reflow measurement with a single-reflow batch approach: all cells are cloned into a DocumentFragment (zero reflows during build), identical content is deduplicated per column via a per-column Set, the entire fragment is appended to a shared offscreen <table> in one call, and all offsetWidth values are read in a single pass (one layout recalculation for the whole table). Eliminates O(N) forced layouts — previously 375s on an 8 000-row table.
Remove the per-100-row await yield (no longer needed); yield once before the loop starts so the overlay renders, then run the batch measurement synchronously.
Clean up the shared offscreen measurement table in the finally block.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Column resize overlay: heading line now updates every 100 rows to show elapsed time and estimated time remaining — '📐 Measuring column widths… 2.3s (5.1s left)'.
Change auto-resize duration display from milliseconds to seconds (2 decimal places) in the info-display status message and the resize debug log line.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Make toggleAutoResizeColumns() async: show a fixed-centre overlay (📐 Measuring column widths…) matching the renderRowsChunked style; chunk the inner row measurement loop at 100 rows with a yield between chunks to keep the page responsive and prevent a Chrome 'page unresponsive' dialog on large tables.
Disable the Resize button during the measurement pass and re-enable it in a finally block so it is always restored even if an error occurs.
Update the auto-resize-on-load setTimeout callback to async/await so the column-size timing measurement captures the full async duration correctly.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Add setting 'sa_auto_resize_columns_threshold' (default 2000): auto-resize on load is now skipped when the rendered row count exceeds this threshold, preventing slow measurement passes on large datasets. Set to 0 to always resize regardless of row count.
Auto-resize on load now appends 'Columnsize measuring time: N.NNs' to the global status display (after 'Rendering time') so the measurement cost is visible in the timing summary.
Auto-resize on load debug log now includes the row count and threshold for easier diagnosis.

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement
items: Make 'Lyrics languages'column collapsable in pageType 'artist-works'

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix row hover highlight regressing to sticky-column-only after the MutationObserver scope fix in 9.99.604: the MusicBrainz native `tr:hover > td` CSS rule is silently defeated by inline style.background values on <td> elements (sticky cell, mb-re-cell, mb-rel-cell, mb-ice-cell injected cells all receive inline backgrounds), and the broad body-level observer had been incidentally propping up Vivaldi's hover-state evaluation via continuous reflows. Fix: extend applyStickyColumn's existing JS hover approach from the sticky cell only to every <td> in each row — at _apply() time, every non-sticky cell's inline background is cleared so CSS zebra striping drives the colour and the computed rest-state is snapshotted into dataset.mbRestBg; the shared _enter handler sets hoverBgColor (default #e2e2e2, configurable via sa_ui_row_hover_bg) on all cells; _leave restores sticky cells to dataset.mbStickyBg and non-sticky cells to '' so CSS zebra takes over. hoverBgColor is evaluated once per _apply() call outside the forEach loop.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix SyntaxError 'Unexpected token )' at line 18738 (installed): the str_replace that rewrote the subtable toggleSubTableAutoResize measurement loop in 9.99.604 left an orphaned tail fragment — a duplicate measureDiv.appendChild(liClone) and closing }); pair after the correctly-closed querySelectorAll('ul > li').forEach block, producing an unmatched closing parenthesis. Removed the two orphaned lines. Node.js --input-type=module parse confirms file is syntax-clean.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix colStyleCache construction in toggleAutoResizeColumns (global loop) calling Array.prototype.indexOf.call(headers, th) on a NodeList — NodeList is not an Array, making indexOf unreliable across engines, and the index was already available as the second parameter of the .map() callback. Changed map(th => ...) to map((th, i) => ...) and replaced the indexOf call with the i parameter directly.

sections.label: ⚡ Performance
items: Column resize drag: throttle onMouseMove writes to one requestAnimationFrame per frame via a _dragRafPending flag, capping col.style.width DOM writes to 60 fps regardless of mouse-event rate and eliminating the per-pixel synchronous reflow storm during drag.

Column resize drag: cache the target <col> element in _targetCol at mousedown time so onMouseMove never re-queries the DOM; table.style.tableLayout='fixed' is also set once at mousedown instead of on every mousemove. _targetCol falls back to setColumnWidth() if the element is detached by a concurrent re-render.

Auto-resize measurement loops (toggleAutoResizeColumns and toggleSubTableAutoResize): hoist getComputedStyle reads outside the row loop into a colStyleCache array built once per column header, reducing getComputedStyle calls from O(rows×cols) to O(cols).

Auto-resize measurement loops: replace per-element measureDiv.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(el => el.style.setProperty(...)) loops (a micro-reflow per cloned element per cell) with a single .mb-measure-nowrap CSS class on the measureDiv. The class is injected into the sticky-header stylesheet with white-space:nowrap !important, overflow-wrap:normal !important, word-break:normal !important covering the div and all its descendants, eliminating all per-element style loops in both the global and subtable measurement paths including the CAA/EAA art-li section.

Sidebar MutationObserver: change observe target from document.body (childList+subtree — fired on every DOM mutation anywhere on the page, including every cell clone appended during auto-resize) to sidebar (childList+subtree+attributes, attributeFilter:['class','style']). Add _sidebarRafPending deduplication guard so bursts of sidebar mutations only queue one getBoundingClientRect() read per animation frame.
window.scroll listener on sidebar handle: throttle with _scrollRafPending rAF guard (same pattern) to cap getBoundingClientRect() reads to one per paint cycle during scroll.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix saveTableDataToDisk(): when the user saves at the render-threshold dialog without rendering, the serialized headers now reflect the final rendered column layout instead of the native pre-render DOM structure. Detection: absence of mb-original-column class on any <th> (stamped by cleanupHeaders() only after rendering). Fix: clone the native thead and run cleanupHeaders() on the detached clone — this removes checkbox/Relationships/Tagger/Rating columns and injects all synthetic headers (CAA, Country, Date, Total Tracks, DD/MM/YYYY/Day/Month, MB-Name, Comment, injected Relationships) that the active column pipeline would produce, so that the stored headers are aligned with the already-correctly-processed row data in allRows.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix makeH2sCollapsible(): bare text nodes between an <h2> and the next <h2> (e.g. 'No one has reviewed … yet.' in the Reviews section on ratings-entity pages) were not captured by the nextElementSibling walk and therefore not hidden on collapse. Changed to walk nextSibling instead, wrapping non-empty text nodes in a <span> in-place so they participate in the same show/hide mechanism as element siblings.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Rename first column from 'Ratings' (plural) to 'Rating' (singular) for pageTypes 'user-ratings' (all sub-tables) and 'user-ratings-type' (single table): updated Structure H _colHeaders array, both pageType integerColumns sourceColumn references, the Events entityFeatures integerColumns entry, and all related comments.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items:
Add pageType 'ratings-entity' for ///ratings pages (e.g. /work//ratings): Structure I in applyListToTable converts the

Ratings

+
    to a 2-column table (Rating | User); the optional private-rating paragraph and average-rating widget are moved from after the list to between the h2 and the rendered table; integerColumns center-aligns the Rating column; button label is dynamically set to 'Show all Ratings for ' via a new labelFromPathEntity flag that reads the first URL path segment.
Add 'ratings' to the @include sub-path directive so Tampermonkey injects the script on entity ratings URLs.

Add labelFromPathEntity: true button flag and rendering block (parallel to labelFromPath / labelFromH2 / labelFromType) that reads the first URL path segment as the entity type (e.g. 'work' → 'Work', 'release-group' → 'Release group').

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: editor-subscribers: fix 'Plus N other anonymous users' row reappearing after sort — the row was removed from the DOM in finalCleanup but not from the in-memory allRows / originalAllRows arrays; sort rebuilt the tbody from those arrays, re-inserting the row. Added splice calls (same pattern as the 'View all ratings' fix) to remove it from both arrays immediately after DOM removal.

editor-subscribers: rename column header from 'Subscribers' (plural h2 text) to 'Subscriber' (singular) by applying _toSingular() in Structure C column-name derivation, consistent with how tag-value-entity and user-tag-value-entity pages singularise their column names.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: user-ratings-type: action button label is now dynamic — the last URL path segment (e.g. 'recording') is converted to its plural entityFeatures key ('Recordings') and the button reads 'Show Ratings for Recordings' instead of a hardcoded string. Implemented via a new labelFromPath: true button flag and a corresponding rendering block (parallel to the existing labelFromH2 / labelFromType mechanisms).

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Add column-header tooltip for the 'Event-Additional-Info' synthetic column in the eventParts tooltip switch, consistent with the existing tooltips for Event-Type, Event-Date, Event-Detail, Event-Venue, Event-Venue-Detail, Event-City, Event-State, and Event-Country.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: eventParts extractor: split 'Event-Country' on the first ';' to capture trailing text (e.g. 'USA; intro' → Country='USA', Additional-Info='intro') into a new ninth synthetic column 'Event-Additional-Info'. Updated all nine syntheticColumnExtractors declarations across pageType definitions, the JSDoc, the array length (8→9), and the sa_enable_event_parts_extractor settings description.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Add missing extractors to rating pages.
Center align the 'Ratings' integer column.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix user-ratings-type list-to-table conversion: entity-specific ratings pages (/user/<username>/ratings/<entity>) use the same <h2>+<ul> DOM structure as the overview page, not a native table.tbl. Add listToTable: [''] to user-ratings-type features and extend the Structure H trigger from 'user-ratings'-only to 'user-ratings' || 'user-ratings-type' so applyListToTable converts the single <h2>+<ul> pair into a table.tbl before renderFinalTable runs. Also replace the hardcoded 'user-ratings' string in the Structure H debug log with the pageType variable.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Add missing @match directive for user-ratings-type pages (*://*.musicbrainz.org/user/*/ratings/*) so Tampermonkey injects the script on entity-specific ratings URLs (e.g. /user/vzell/ratings/recording).
Remove unused 'params' parameter from the user-ratings match function signature (body only tests the path regex, consistent with other path-only matchers).

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Complete user-ratings-type pageType for /user/<username>/ratings/<entity> pages (e.g. /user/vzell/ratings/event, /user/vzell/ratings/work): fix match regex (was requiring an extra path segment, now correctly matches /user/[^/]+/ratings/[^/]+$); add features.integerColumns for the Ratings column; add resolveEntityFeaturesFromH2 [user-ratings-type] block that maps the singular URL slug (recording, event, release-group, …) to the plural entityFeatures key (Recordings, Events, Release groups, …), giving each entity page the same column structure as the corresponding sub-table on the user-ratings overview page; extend both Ratings-column removal guards to also cover user-ratings-type so the script's own Ratings column is never treated as a native MB Rating column.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix video icon appearing in an extra phantom column on user-ratings Recordings rows: the 'Recordings' entityFeatures was using Name_Comment_Artists (syntheticColumns: ['Name','Comment','Artist']), which appended a redundant Artist <td> even though 'Artist' already exists as an original column in the recording-ratings table. Changed to Name_Comment (syntheticColumns: ['Name','Comment']) so no duplicate Artist cell is emitted; moved the video extractor first so the column order is Ratings | Recording | Artist | Video | Name | Comment.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Wire up entityFeatures on user-ratings pages to work like tag-value: (1) Structure H stores mbEntityFeaturesKey (_entityType+'s') so the fetch loop can resolve entityFeatures by plural key ('Artists', 'Events', etc.) even though the h3 category text is 'Artist ratings'; (2) the per-group extractor rebuild (tag-value path) now also runs for user-ratings, re-resolving activeColumnExtractors/integerColumns from the group's entity-specific feature set; (3) the user-ratings per-group thead builder in renderGroupedTable now also rebuilds extractors from group.entityFeatures, resolves colIdx from the freshly built thead cells, and calls cleanupHeaders to inject synthetic <th>s (Name, Comment, Date, etc.); (4) cleanupHeaders gains a user-ratings guard on the sa_remove_rating loop so the custom 'Ratings' column is never removed.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items:
Fix one-position column name shift on user-ratings pages: the Structure H while loop in applyListToTable now stops traversal when it encounters an H3 or H2 heading, preventing the injected

Ratings

from crossing past 'Artist ratings' h3 to steal its UL. Previously every section received the previous section's entity type as column 2 (e.g. 'Artist ratings' showed col2='Ratings', 'Event ratings' showed col2='Artist').

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Add pageType 'user-ratings' for /user//ratings pages: new @match directive, page definition with renameH2ToH3 + insertH2 'Ratings' features, and Structure H in applyListToTable that walks h3+ul pairs and builds 2-column tables (Ratings | EntityType) for sections without artist credit (e.g. Artist ratings, Work ratings) and 3-column tables (Ratings | EntityType | Artist) for sections containing ' by' or ' by' (e.g. Recording ratings, Release group ratings). The trailing 'View all ratings' list item becomes a mb-show-all-subtable-btn overflow button in the h3 header via a new renderGroupedTable block. Per-group thead width is driven by dataset.mbColHeaders (JSON) propagated from applyListToTable through the fetch-loop group object. The sa_remove_rating exclusion is guarded to avoid incorrectly stripping the custom 'Ratings' column on user-ratings pages.

sections.label: 🧹 Cleanup
items: Remove unused _eplGlyphs arrow function (defined in the Pinned Filter List editor closure but never called — _eplRender uses plain ✓ checkmarks instead of HTML badge spans)
Remove unused _relFetchFaviconUrl function (dead code; also used GM_xmlhttpRequest which was replaced by fetch() in 9.99.586)

sections.label: 📝 Documentation
items: Add JSDoc to updateSubTableCollapseButton: documents collapse-button visibility logic and highlight tinting
Add JSDoc to _syncGfClearBtn: documents global-filter ✕ button visibility sync
Add JSDoc to _initRelTooltipListeners: documents idempotent tooltip delegation installer
Add JSDoc to initRelationshipsColumn: documents full execution flow (cache hierarchy, cell injection, WS2 fetch)
Add JSDoc to _artInitInlinePics: documents CAA/EAA inline thumbnail injection with ctx/cacheBust/targetTable params

Resync ShowAllEntityData_HELP.txt against current codebase: add FILTER STATUS DISPLAY section (✓ Filtered N rows [GLOBAL/SUB-TABLE/COLUMN FILTER format]), add HIDDEN-MATCH INDICATOR ON MULTI-ROW COLLAPSE BUTTONS section, expand RELATIONSHIPS COLUMN section with rich filter-aware tooltip and filter-match highlighting

sections.label: 🐛 Bug Fixes
items: Fix artist-releasegroups (and all other fetched pages) returning 0 tables on Firefox for Android: root cause identified via console fetch() test — a page-context fetch() to the same URL returned 425 KB of correct HTML with tables, while GM_xmlhttpRequest returned different content with no tables; GM_xmlhttpRequest in Tampermonkey for Firefox Android runs in the extension background context which does NOT share the foreground tab's cookie jar, so MusicBrainz served a different response; fixed by replacing GM_xmlhttpRequest with native fetch(url, {credentials:'same-origin'}) in fetchHtml(), which runs in the page context sharing the same session cookies and network stack as normal browser navigation; also reverts the incorrect navigator.userAgent header workaround added in 9.99.585 which was based on a wrong diagnosis

sections.label: 🐛 Bug Fixes
items: Fix artist-releasegroups fetch returning 0 tables on Firefox for Android (Tampermonkey): GM_xmlhttpRequest was sending the raw Android mobile User-Agent instead of the browser's active UA; when 'Request Desktop Site' is enabled in Firefox, navigator.userAgent is overridden to a desktop UA for normal page loads but GM_xmlhttpRequest did not inherit that override, causing MusicBrainz to serve a mobile-layout page with no <table class="tbl"> elements; fixed by explicitly forwarding navigator.userAgent as the 'User-Agent' header in every GM_xmlhttpRequest call in fetchHtml()

Replace blocking alert('No tables found to resize') in toggleAutoResizeColumns() with a Lib.warn()-only path; the alert was confusing on mobile and could appear as a side-effect of any empty-fetch condition (e.g. mobile UA mismatch) rather than as a direct result of a user resize action

sections.label: 🐛 Bug Fixes
items: Fix spurious filter/highlight matches in multi-row cells (Catalog#, Label, …): the 'mb-cell-collapse-toggle' UI widget ('▶ 2 ▤') was included in the filterable text, causing cross-tag matches between the last character(s) of a cell value and the numeric item-count badge (e.g. filter '12' matched trailing '1' of 'DT 0017-1311' plus '2' of the count badge); fixed by adding '.mb-cell-collapse-toggle' to _CLEAN_STRIP_SEL (getCleanColumnText clone-and-strip pass), to the FILTER_REJECT list in the highlightCrossTag TreeWalker, and to the secondary guard in getCleanColumnText's own TreeWalker

sections.label: 🐛 Bug Fixes
items: Fix per-h3 filter-status going blank after pressing the H3 sub-table 'Clear all filters' button (.mb-subtable-clear-btn) when a global filter is still active: replaced the dispatchEvent('input') call (which scheduled a debounced applySubFilter() that fired after runFilter() and wiped the status span) with a direct DOM lookup of the STF ✕ button (id ending in '-clear' inside .mb-stf-input-wrap) to hide it without triggering applySubFilter()

sections.label: 🐛 Bug Fixes
items: Remove unconditional filter-status overwrite ('✓ All column filters cleared') triggered by the H3 sub-table 'Clear all filters' button (clearSubTableColumnFilters), which wiped the filter status display even when a global filter was still active; debug log message for the button press is retained

sections.label: 🐛 Bug Fixes
items: Remove unconditional filter-status overwrite ('✓ All filters cleared' / '✓ All column filters cleared') triggered by the 'Clear ALL column filters' and 'Clear ALL filters' buttons in the H2 header bar, which incorrectly replaced the current filter status even when filters were still active; debug log messages for both button presses are retained

sections.label: 🧹 Cleanup
items: Reorder configuration section
Add licenses from userscripts from which functionality has been incorporated
Change @name in userscript header

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement
items: Filter/sort status display — three format changes applied consistently to both single-table and multi-table modes: (1) Sort status: column names now use single quotes instead of double quotes — '"Country/Date"▲' → '\'Country/Date\'▲' — for both multi-sort (mb-sort-status span) and single-sort (Sorted by:) paths in both multi-table per-h3 and single-table main status displays. Also fixed the multi-table single-sort format to use the 'Sorted by:' form with parenthesised row count, matching the already-correct single-table single-sort path. (2) Filter status: column names in COLUMN FILTER entries no longer include multi-sort superscript suffixes (¹ ² ³ etc.) — the col-name strip regex at all filter-status build sites is extended to also remove Unicode superscript digits (⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹) so '\'Title ¹\':"II"' renders as '\'Title\':"II"'. (3) Single-table filter status: changed '✓ Global filter: N rows in Xms' to '✓ Filtered N rows in Xms' to be symmetric with the multi-table per-h3 format. The mode label (Regexp filter, Case-sensitive filter, etc.) that previously appeared as the prefix is now dropped — the filter details inside the brackets already convey that information via the mode flags.

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement
items: Standardise filter status display format across single-table and multi-table modes: (1) Filter type labels are now UPPERCASE — 'GLOBAL:', 'SUB-TABLE:', 'N COLUMN FILTER(S)' — making them visually distinct from the quoted filter values. (2) Column filter entries are now always symmetric regardless of count — '1 COLUMN FILTER [\'Format\':"vinyl"]' uses the same bracketed list format as '2 COLUMN FILTERS [\'Format\':"vinyl\', \'Country\':"JP"]'. (3) Column names are always enclosed in single quotes — '\'Format\':\"vinyl\"' — distinguishing them from the double-quoted filter values. All three changes are applied consistently to both call sites in multi-table mode (runFilter per-h3 block and applySubFilter per-h3 block) and the single-table filterParts / filterInfo block.

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement
items: Add sub-table filter (STF) info to the per-h3 filter status span in multi-table mode. Previously the span (class mb-filter-status, sibling to the mb-sort-status span in the h3 header) only showed column filter details and was completely blank when only a global or STF filter was active. The status now mirrors the single-table h2 format: '✓ Filtered N rows [global:"x", sub-table:"y", ColA:"z"]', listing all active filter layers for this specific sub-table. Mode flags (case, rx, ex) are appended in parentheses when active: e.g. 'sub-table:(rx) "jp.*"'. Single column filter shown inline ('ColA:"val"'), multiple as '2 col filters [ColA:"v1", ColB:"v2"]'. The update happens in two call sites: runFilter() (covers global/column filter changes that do not trigger applySubFilter) and applySubFilter() at the end of step 5 (covers STF-only filtering which never calls runFilter). The status is cleared in both the !raw early-return branch and clearSubFilter().

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix 'mb-subtable-clear-btn' (Clear all filters) and 'mb-clear-all-filters-btn' (Clear ALL filters) buttons remaining visible after clearing the sub-table filter via Delete/Backspace keystroke: the applySubFilter !raw early-return branch (added in 9.99.575) was missing the window.updateFilterButtonsVisibility() call that clearSubFilter() performs. Added the call to the !raw branch so all three clear paths (Escape key, ✕ button, and Delete/Backspace) correctly hide those buttons when no filter is active.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix CAA/EAA bigbox (image stripe) not restoring all images after clearing the sub-table filter (STF) on multi-table pages: after filtering (e.g. 'jp' → 3 images shown), clearing the filter correctly restored all 4 rows but the bigbox still showed only 3 images (the non-matching row's anchor kept display:none from the previous applySubFilter pass). Root cause: two separate clear paths both failed to call caaUpdateBigBoxForTable / eaaUpdateBigBoxForTable. (1) The STF ✕ clear button click handler called filterInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')) which routed through debouncedApply() → applySubFilter(). When applySubFilter runs with an empty input, it takes the !raw early-return branch which restores table rows but has no bigbox sync call — only clearSubFilter() (called by Escape key) performed the bigbox sync. Fix: change the ✕ click handler to call clearSubFilter() directly, matching the Escape key handler. (2) The delete-key/backspace path also went through debouncedApply() → applySubFilter() → !raw branch with no bigbox sync. Fix: add caaUpdateBigBoxForTable / eaaUpdateBigBoxForTable calls to the applySubFilter !raw early-return block so that the bigbox is always resync'd when the filter is cleared regardless of which input method was used.

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement
items: Single-table sort status: reformat single-column sort to match the multi-sort style — '✓ Sorted by: "Catalog#"▲ (7 rows in 42ms)' instead of the old '✓ Sorted by column "Catalog#" ▲: 7 rows in 42ms'. This makes single and multi-column sort statuses visually consistent.

Single-table filter status: expand the column-filter summary from '2 column filters' to '2 column filters ["Catalog#":"to", "Barcode":"val"]', listing each active column filter's column name and current value. Column names are derived from the thead th elements (sort/unique-values glyphs stripped). Multi-table pages are unchanged — per-table column details continue to appear in the h3 sort-status span.

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement
items: Add syntheticColumnExtractors with extractor 'eventParts' on sourceColumn 'Comment' and syntheticColumns ['Event-Type', 'Event-Date', 'Event-Detail', 'Event-Venue', 'Event-Venue-Detail', 'Event-City', 'Event-State', 'Event-Country'] to five page type definitions: artist-recordings, instrument-recordings, area-recordings-filtered, area-recordings, work-recordings.

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement
items: Global filter status display: append ' cleared' to the mode label when the global filter string is empty AND no column filters are active, so the status reads '✓ Global filter cleared' (or '✓ Regexp filter cleared', etc.) instead of the ambiguous bare '✓ Global filter'. The suffix is only added when the cleared state is the sole active state — if column filters are still active the label stays as-is so the user knows filtering is still in effect. Applied to both the multi-table path (mb-filter-status-display in the header bar) and the single-table path (where the status also includes row-count and timing).

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement / 🐛 Fix
items: Revert 9.99.570 (caaYesCount/caaNoCount IIFE computation and makeArtItem calls) — it re-introduced the substring false-positive bug fixed in 9.99.569. The correct solution (requested by user after testing) is purely cosmetic: for CAA/EAA columns only, rename the two existing makeSynItem cell-structure labels to artwork-presence equivalents — '○ empty cells' → '✗ no artwork', '▶◀ any multi-row cells' → '✓ has artwork'. The underlying multirow-mode filtering (applyMultiRowMode / testRowMatch isMultiRowFilter path) is completely unchanged; the new labels simply make the intent clearer for image columns. Also remove the now-dead else-if branch that showed the old makeArtItem entries under a separate 'Cell structure' header for non-collapsable CAA/EAA columns (those cases are now fully handled by the renamed makeSynItem entries in the main collapsable block).

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix '✓ has artwork' and '✗ no artwork' entries disappearing from the CAA/EAA column unique-values dropdown after 9.99.569 added '.mb-caa-sort-key' to _CLEAN_STRIP_SEL: caaYesCount and caaNoCount were computed from valueCounts.get('yes') and valueCounts.get('no'), but valueCounts is built by iterating getCleanColumnText on each cell — which now strips .mb-caa-sort-key, so 'yes'/'no' are never accumulated and both counts are always 0. Fix: compute caaYesCount and caaNoCount by directly querying '.mb-caa-sort-key' / '.mb-eaa-sort-key' in each visible tbody cell and checking textContent === 'yes' or 'no', bypassing getCleanColumnText entirely.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix CAA/EAA column '✗ no artwork' and '✓ has artwork' quick-filter entries matching false-positive rows: clicking '✗ no artwork' set the column filter value to the plain string 'no', which was then used as a substring match by getCleanColumnText / testRowMatch — matching 'not readable' in image comments, 'no' in sort-key spans, and any other visible text containing 'no'. Fix mirrors the existing mb-inline-art-sort-key sentinel pattern exactly: (1) Add '.mb-caa-sort-key' and '.mb-eaa-sort-key' to _CLEAN_STRIP_SEL so the sentinel values 'yes'/'no' are stripped from getCleanColumnText output and never participate in substring matching. (2) Add both classes to the getCleanVisibleText FILTER_REJECT list for the same reason. (3) Add both classes to the highlightCrossTag FILTER_REJECT list in getCleanColumnText to prevent the highlight pass from inserting highlight spans inside the invisible sort-key span. (4) Add a 'CAA/EAA sort-key bypass' block in testRowMatch immediately after the existing mb-inline-art-sort-key bypass: when the column filter value is 'yes' or 'no' (non-regexp mode), look up .mb-caa-sort-key / .mb-eaa-sort-key in the column cell and compare textContent with an exact-match test, bypassing the normal substring/regex matching. This ensures '✓ has artwork' / '✗ no artwork' match exactly the rows with artwork / without artwork respectively, with no false positives.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix Relationships rich tooltip showing all filter-layer highlights with the same visual style: _serialiseKeySpan was converting every highlight span (mb-global-filter-highlight, mb-subtable-filter-highlight, mb-column-filter-highlight, mb-pre-filter-highlight) to a generic <mark style="..."> element with a single hardcoded yellow/red inline style, so all three layers appeared identical. Fix: preserve the original class name from the DOM span by emitting <span class="{originalClass}"> instead of <mark>. The per-layer CSS rules already defined in the userscript stylesheet then apply naturally inside the tooltip div (which is part of the same DOM), making each filter layer visually distinct without any additional styling code.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix ReferenceError: _ensureRelPlainTooltip is not defined — second missing function from the same 9.99.565 cleanup-script accident. The function _ensureRelPlainTooltip (the singleton creator for div#mb-rel-plain-tooltip) was located between the two splice markers used by the cleanup and was therefore deleted along with the stale duplicates. Restored.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix Relationships column completely empty (cells show MBID but no icons, no data-rel-done attribute) — regression introduced in 9.99.565: the stale-duplicate cleanup script removed the four module-level let declarations (_relTooltipListenersInstalled, _relTooltipTimer, _relTooltipEl, _relPlainTooltipEl) that were between the removed block and _initRelTooltipListeners. Without them, _initRelTooltipListeners() throws ReferenceError: _relTooltipListenersInstalled is not defined on its very first line, which propagates out of the async initRelationshipsColumn() as a rejected promise — aborting the function before any WS2 fetches or cell population can occur. Fix: restore the four let declarations immediately before _initRelTooltipListeners.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix four related Relationships column highlight bugs (all caused by the tooltip and icon-match systems trying to re-compute filter matches independently instead of reading the authoritative highlight spans already stamped in the DOM): (1) Rich tooltip showed only ONE filter layer — _relGetActiveQuery returned the first non-empty layer and ignored the rest, so with global='discogs' + STF='item=' only 'item=' appeared in the tooltip and 'discogs' was silently dropped. (2) Rich tooltip used wrong highlight span class — _relBuildTooltipHTML re-applied the filter string with its own regex, producing generic <mark> instead of preserving the actual mb-global-filter-highlight / mb-subtable-filter-highlight / mb-column-filter-highlight classes that are already correctly stamped in the .mb-rel-filter-key span by the main highlight pipeline. (3) mb-rel-icon-match (red border on matching icons) was permanently cleared when STF changed — applySubFilter step 2 cleared all mb-rel-icon-match markers from anchors, then the STF hit block only restored them for STF matches; the global and column filter markers set by testRowMatch were never restored. Clearing STF left all icons without the red border even though the global filter was still active and matching. (4) Tooltip gate checked wrong condition — _relQueryMatchesCell re-evaluated filter strings from live inputs rather than inspecting the DOM highlight spans. Fix for all four: _relBuildTooltipHTML now serialises the existing .mb-rel-filter-key child nodes directly (_serialiseKeySpan), converting any highlight span of any class to a <mark> — the complete, accurate union of all active filter layers with no re-computation. _relQueryMatchesCell now checks the DOM for any highlight span inside .mb-rel-filter-key (one querySelectorAll, no regex). _relHasAnyActiveFilter provides a cheap first gate (checks inputs are non-empty). applySubFilter step 2 now immediately re-derives mb-rel-icon-match after clearing: it scans each td.mb-rel-cell anchor's .mb-rel-filter-key for existing mb-global-filter-highlight or mb-column-filter-highlight spans and restores the class if found, so the global/column icon state is preserved across STF changes.

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement / 🐛 Fix
items: Relationships rich HTML tooltip: show only when filter matches (not merely when any filter is active). Previously the rich tooltip appeared whenever a filter string was present on any layer (global, STF, column), even if that filter matched a different column and left the hovered Relationships cell's URLs completely unhighlighted. New helper _relQueryMatchesCell(cell, filterCtx) checks whether the active filter query matches at least one URL in the hovered cell's .mb-rel-filter-key spans; if it does not match, the custom panels are suppressed entirely and the native browser title tooltip is shown instead (the title attribute is no longer blanked on that hover). The native tooltip is now ONLY suppressed when both conditions are true: a filter is active AND it matches this specific cell.

Relationships rich HTML tooltip: change default colors to white background (#ffffff) and black text (#000000) for both the rich URL-list panel and the plain-text panel. Previously both panels used a dark-navy (#1e1e2e) background with soft-white (#cdd6f4) text. Colors are applied dynamically at show-time (read from settings on each hover) so changes take effect without a page reload.

Add two new settings to the RELATIONSHIPS COLUMN SECTION of configSchema: 'sa_rel_tooltip_bg' (color_picker, default #ffffff) — background color for the rich HTML Relationships tooltip panels; 'sa_rel_tooltip_color' (color_picker, default #000000) — text color for the same panels. Both apply to both the rich URL-list panel and the plain-text anchor-title panel displayed to its right.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix / ✨ Enhancement
items: Fix native browser title tooltip overlapping the rich HTML Relationships tooltip (introduced in 9.99.562): the browser's built-in tooltip appears after its own OS-level delay and renders on top of the rich panel in an unpredictable position. Fix: on mouseenter, blank the anchor's title attribute immediately (storing the original in data-rel-title-saved) so the browser never shows its native tooltip; on mouseleave, restore the original value so keyboard-focus tooltips and subsequent hovers still work. Add a second custom plain-text tooltip panel (div#mb-rel-plain-tooltip, same dark-panel aesthetic) that renders the saved title text and is positioned to the top-right of the rich tooltip (8px gap). If the plain panel would overflow the right edge of the viewport it flips to the left side of the rich panel instead. Both panels are hidden together by a shared _hideAll() helper on mouseleave from either the anchor or the cell.

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement
items: Add rich HTML tooltip popup to Relationships column icon anchors (td.mb-rel-cell a). Previously, hovering an icon showed the browser's native title-attribute tooltip containing the raw URL or 'relType: Title\nURL' text. The new tooltip is a styled dark-panel popup (matching the art bigbox tooltip aesthetic) that lists all relationship URLs present in the hovered cell — one per line — each prefixed with the site favicon. If a filter is active on any layer, occurrences of the filter string within each URL are highlighted in yellow/red (matching the global filter highlight colours). Filter query resolution probes three layers in order, using the first non-empty one: (1) column-level filter on the Relationships column (per-sub-table Rx/Case checkboxes respected), (2) sub-table filter (STF) for the owning h3 (per-sub-table Rx/Case checkboxes respected), (3) global filter (global Rx/Case checkboxes used). Ended relationships are shown with a subtle '(ended)' annotation. The tooltip appears after a 300ms hover delay to avoid flicker, follows the anchor horizontally (clamped to viewport), and is dismissed immediately on mouseleave. Implemented as three new helpers (_ensureRelTooltip, _relGetActiveQuery, _relBuildTooltipHTML) and a body-level capture-phase delegation listener (_initRelTooltipListeners) installed idempotently once from initRelationshipsColumn.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix ghost column (empty grey cells with no header or filter field) appearing as the last column on pageType 'place-performances' (multi-table mode) and potentially any other multi-table page type that uses both injectedColumns with injectedColumnExtractors and the Release-events suppress guard. Root cause was a four-step race: (1) Initial renderGroupedTable call (query='', new-table path) moves source rows from groupedRows into the tbody and calls _suppressReleaseEventsIfNoReleaseLinks, which finds the ICE <th> elements (Release country, Release date, R-DD, R-MM, R-YYYY, R-Day, R-Month), removes them from the thead, and calls tr.deleteCell() on each source row to remove the corresponding mb-ice-cell <td>s. (2) The async initReleaseEventsColumn() callback fires after render, populates mb-re-cell cells, then calls applyInjectedColumnExtractors(). (3) applyInjectedColumnExtractors calls _ensureIceCells on every source row in groupedRows: it sees the rows have 0 mb-ice-cell cells (suppress already removed them) and re-appends all 7 ICE placeholder cells, then _processRow fills them. (4) On the next render (runFilter or view switch), clones of the re-injected source rows carry 7 mb-ice-cell cells; _suppressReleaseEventsIfNoReleaseLinks finds no ICE <th> in the existing thead (they were removed in step 1), so _indicesToRemove is empty and the function returns early without removing the ICE cells from the clones. The 7 orphan cells render as ghost columns beyond the 13 real header cells. Fix: in _suppressReleaseEventsIfNoReleaseLinks step 2, after deleting ICE cells from each row, stamp data-mb-ice-suppressed='1' on the row. In _ensureIceCells inside applyInjectedColumnExtractors, check for this flag and return immediately without re-adding ICE cells. Since cloneNode(true) copies dataset attributes, the flag propagates to all clones produced on subsequent render passes, so the ghost column never reappears regardless of how many filter/sort/view-switch re-renders occur.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Remove the Relationships column from pageType 'place-performances-filtered' (and any other single-table pageType that injects Relationships) when no /release/ or /release-group/ link is present in the table — e.g. https://musicbrainz.org/place/.../performances?direction=1&link_type_id=693. Root cause: _suppressRelationshipsIfNoReleaseOrReleaseGroupLinks() was only called in the multi-table path inside renderGroupedTable(). The single-table path in renderFinalTable() already called the parallel _suppressReleaseEventsIfNoReleaseLinks() but was missing the Relationships guard. Fix: add the missing _suppressRelationshipsIfNoReleaseOrReleaseGroupLinks(mainTable) call in renderFinalTable() immediately after _suppressReleaseEventsIfNoReleaseLinks(), before initRelationshipsColumn() creates mb-rel-cell placeholder <td>s.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix global and column-level filtering in the 'Complete Discography (merged)' view on artist-releasegroups pages: (1) filtering showed only one of the N combined rows (e.g. only the Official match for 'Devils & Dust', missing the Non-Official match); (2) clearing the filter afterwards showed only the Official rows — the merged combination was permanently lost until the user switched views. Root cause: runFilter() iterates groupedRows per-group (group 0 = Album Official: 21 rows, group 1 = Album Non-Official: 2 rows) and builds filteredArray accordingly, then calls renderGroupedTable(filteredArray) which replaces each table's tbody with only that group's matching rows. For the merged view, the first-occurrence 'Album' table's merged tbody (containing all 23 combined rows) was silently replaced with only the 21 Official rows, destroying the merged state. Sub-table filtering was unaffected because applySubFilter operates on the live DOM rows directly without touching groupedRows. Fix: in the runFilter() multi-table forEach loop, when discographyViewState === 'merged', two special cases are applied. (a) Hidden duplicate tables (h3.dataset.mbDiscHidden === 'true'): contribute nothing — an empty rows:[] entry is pushed to filteredArray so renderGroupedTable does not touch their hidden tbody, and their row count is subtracted from totalAbsolute to avoid double-counting in the h2 stat. (b) First-occurrence merged tables: reconstruct the combined row source by collecting all groupedRows entries that share the same category name (mirroring the _mergedFirstIdxByName logic in _applyDiscographyViewFilter), then filter against that combined set. After renderGroupedTable runs, a post-render fixup re-stamps data-mb-merged-tbody='true' on the first-occurrence tables so the restore-from-merged pre-pass in _applyDiscographyViewFilter correctly identifies them when the user next switches views.

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement
items: When switching discography views on artist-releasegroups pages (📋 Complete / 📀 Official / 📼 Non-Official / 🗂️ Complete merged), all filter, sort, highlight, h3-collapse, and CAA/EAA bigbox state is now unconditionally reset to the initial rendered state before the new view is applied. Previously, active filters, sort orders, and highlight spans from one view leaked into the next, causing wrong row counts, stale highlights, incorrect sort indicators, and visual artefacts in the merged view. The reset is performed by the new helper _resetDiscographyViewState(), called at the top of _applyDiscographyViewFilter() before any DOM manipulation. The eight reset steps are: (1) global filter cleared to prefix-only; (2) all column filter inputs cleared; (3) all sub-table filters (STF) cleared — value, STF-hidden row markers, mb-subtable-filter-highlight spans, border/shadow, container visibility, and toggle-icon active state; (4) brute-force removal of any remaining filter-highlight spans (mb-global-filter-highlight, mb-column-filter-highlight, mb-pre-filter-highlight, mb-subtable-filter-highlight); (5) sort state reset — multi-sort column tints cleared, .sort-icon-active stripped from all sort buttons, superscript priority digits removed, mb-sort-status spans blanked, multiTableSortStates and multiSortTintRegistry cleared, and all sub-table tbody rows re-inserted in the original groupedRows order; (6) runFilter() called to re-render all visible tables with the clean filter state; (7) h3 collapse state reset to initial shouldStayOpen logic (expanded for single sub-tables and small album/official groups, collapsed otherwise); (8) all CAA/EAA bigboxes collapsed (display:none) with dataset.caaVisible/eaaVisible set to 'false' so the h3 click handler and _artRestoreBigboxesForTable see the correct collapsed baseline when the user later expands a sub-table.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix two Unicode character picker keyboard bugs caused by the mb.unicodechars userscript by Smeulf being active on the same MusicBrainz page simultaneously: (1) ArrowUp/Down keys did not navigate the list immediately after opening — only after pressing Escape once; (2) closing the dialog required three Escape presses instead of one. Root cause: mb.unicodechars loads before this script and therefore registers its bubble-phase Ctrl+U and navigation keydown listeners first. When Ctrl+U was pressed, mb.unicodechars opened ITS dialog first (bubble phase, registered earlier), then our bubble-phase handler opened OURS on top — so both dialogs were open simultaneously. With both open, mb.unicodechars navigation handlers fired before ours and called stopImmediatePropagation(), preventing our saUnicodeHandleKey from ever being reached. The three-Escape sequence was: 1st Escape closes mb.unicodechars dialog (their handler fires first, stops propagation), 2nd Escape is caught by the STF/col-filter input Escape handler (clears or blurs, stops propagation), 3rd Escape finally reaches our saUnicodeHandleKey. Fix: move both the Ctrl+U opener and the saUnicodeHandleKey navigation out of the bubble-phase keydown listener and into a new dedicated capture-phase listener (document.addEventListener('keydown', ..., true)). Capture-phase listeners fire before any bubble-phase listener regardless of registration order. saUnicodeHandleKey already calls e.stopImmediatePropagation() for all handled keys (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Escape), so once it runs, neither the mb.unicodechars bubble handler nor the STF/col-filter Escape handlers see the event. This is the same strategy already used by the Ctrl+M prefix-key handler to defeat the 'mb. SUPER MIND CONTROL' script's bubble-phase Ctrl+M listener.

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement
items: Add visual 'hidden match' indicator (yellow background / red ▶ glyph) to CAA/EAA art column expand buttons ([data-caa-expand-btn]) when any filter layer (global, column, or sub-table) matches content hidden inside a collapsed art cell. The indicator fires for all three filter modes and is cleared when the cell is expanded or the filter is cleared. Mirrors the existing mb-collapse-toggle-has-match behaviour that already existed for renderMultiRowCell columns (Label, Catalog#).

Fix dead code in initCollapsableColumns art-cell hidden-match pass: the toggle was looked up via ':scope > .mb-cell-collapse-toggle' but art cells were refactored to use [data-caa-expand-btn] inside li-0 of ul.mb-caa-art-ul, so the old selector never matched and the pass silently did nothing. Replaced with a correct lookup of the [data-caa-expand-btn] span inside the li-0 summary row.

Extend _syncCollapseHasMatchInTable with a second pass (Pass 2) that re-evaluates mb-collapse-toggle-has-match on all [data-caa-expand-btn] spans in art cells — previously _syncCollapseHasMatchInTable only processed td.mb-has-collapse-toggle cells and completely missed art cells. Pass 2 is called from applySubFilter (after clearing and after stamping STF highlights) and from _artHighlightArtCell (after async art-cell rebuilds).

Add mb-collapse-toggle-has-match handling to the ensureCollapseDelegate CAA/EAA click branch: when expanding, remove the class; when collapsing, check whether any image li still contains a filter highlight and set/clear accordingly.

Extend updateSubTableCollapseButton and updateGlobalCollapseButtonHighlight highlight-detection selectors to include 'td .mb-caa-art-ul .<highlight-class>' in addition to the existing 'td.mb-has-collapse-toggle .<highlight-class>' selectors, so the per-sub-table and global collapse button tints also react to highlights inside art cells.

sections.label: 🎨 Style
items: Add CSS rules '[data-caa-expand-btn].mb-collapse-toggle-has-match' and '[data-caa-expand-btn].mb-collapse-toggle-has-match:hover' with identical yellow-background / red-glyph / box-shadow styling to the existing .mb-cell-collapse-toggle.mb-collapse-toggle-has-match rules. Added border-radius:2px to match the art button's visual style.

sections.label: ✨ Enhancement
items: Add visual 'hidden match' indicator (mb-collapse-toggle-has-match — yellow background / red glyph on the ▶ cell-collapse toggle) for collapsed multi-row cells (renderMultiRowCell columns such as Label / Catalog#) when the sub-table filter (STF) matches content that is currently hidden inside the collapsed cell. Previously this indicator only fired for global-filter and column-filter matches; STF matches in collapsed items were silently invisible to the user.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Introduce module-level constant _COLLAPSE_MATCH_SEL as the single authoritative CSS selector string for detecting any filter-highlight span inside a collapse-toggle cell ('.mb-global-filter-highlight, .mb-column-filter-highlight, .mb-pre-filter-highlight, .mb-subtable-filter-highlight'). All six call sites that previously hard-coded the three-class selector string now use this constant, eliminating the risk of future highlight classes being missed in one place.

Introduce helper function _syncCollapseHasMatchInTable(table) that re-evaluates mb-collapse-toggle-has-match on every .mb-cell-collapse-toggle inside a sub-table. Called from applySubFilter at two points: (1) after step 2 clears STF highlights (removes the indicator from toggles that were lit solely by an STF match), and (2) after step 4 applies new STF highlights (stamps the indicator onto any toggle whose collapsed items now contain an STF match). The helper uses _COLLAPSE_MATCH_SEL so it always reflects the union of all active filter layers regardless of which combination is in effect.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix sub-table filter (STF) silently failing to match rows after any previous filter pass has left fragmented text nodes in the live DOM: when applySubFilter step 2 clears mb-subtable-filter-highlight spans it does `n.replaceWith(document.createTextNode(n.textContent))`, which leaves the replacement text node as a sibling of the surrounding text nodes WITHOUT merging them.
